lines.text: Do you think this change to my game is an improvement or should i scrap it?
lines.note: slow zoom on the portal, ALREADY SPINNING (current main)

lines.text: This guy on my last two shorts asked the same thing, make the portal spin
lines.note: sniper-POV gameplay in the background, with a YouTube-style comment card on screen. Handle and text are a PLACEHOLDER ("@commenter — make the portal spin"), clearly marked.

lines.text: And you know what? I think thats a great idea
lines.note: same shot; the comment card goes away

lines.text: This was simple, i already had the portal waving using a modified version of what i used to make the lava wave
lines.note: the portal waving WITHOUT spinning, filmed from ed473b24~1; the lava wave can show too

lines.text: All I had to do was add a few lines to that shader that rotate the texture around its centre a little more every frame, so the whole swirl turns.
lines.note: Godot-editor-style footage: the portal texture with the spin off, then turned on, holding a beat after it starts.

lines.text: What do you think? should i keep this in or not?
lines.note: more shots of the spinning portal in game

lines.text: Let me know what else you think i should add in the comments and it just might make it into the final game!
